response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per), s1 AS (SELECT per.ordersmark, per.a, per.a - b1.m AS ex1 FROM per, b1 WHERE per.a > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.a, s1.ex1, s1.a - b2.m AS ex2 FROM s1, b2 WHERE s1.a > b2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_of_remaining, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_second FROM s2
